answer: The statutory auditors' limited-assurance certification covers 2025 sustainability information in section 2.2 and Article 8 EU Taxonomy disclosures; limited procedures are less extensive than reasonable-assurance procedures and do not assess the quality of management choices beyond ESRS compliance. Separately, PwC performed reasonable assurance under ISAE 3000 (Revised) on five voluntary indicators: Zero-CO2 sites, renewable-electricity share, measured energy consumption by source, Scope 1 GHG emissions and market-based Scope 2 GHG emissions. The reasonable-assurance scope excludes earlier periods and all other 2025 URD information, and its reporting framework is the dedicated SSI/SSE and environmental protocols rather than Article L.233-28-4/ESRS information.
